# CANDIDATE: RSI_BOS_CONFLUENCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A bearish Break of Structure (BOS) coinciding with RSI bearish divergence signals weakening momentum and a short opportunity. The BOS confirms price structure breakdown while RSI divergence shows weakening upward momentum, increasing probability of continuation to the downside.

## Mechanism

Entry: Identify a bearish BOS (price makes lower low after prior higher low) on the 5-min chart; simultaneously, RSI(14) shows a bearish divergence (price higher high vs RSI lower high) within the last three bars; enter short at the close of the BOS-confirming bar.  
Exit: Chart-stop at prior swing high (the HH that preceded the BOS), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail using premium-stop % (10% of ATR).  
Regime hint: Works in choppy to trending markets when VIX < 22; avoid strong trend days where ribbon is tightly stacked.
